sources.summary: Meta reported that the Fagan ad account was disabled and its ads were paused after a declined payment.
A same-day Meta receipt recorded 30.24 USD of residual August 6 delivery before the disable notice.
A same-day Cash App notice recorded an 84 USD payment from the client marked for Facebook.

conclusion: Fagan remains outside the active paid-media roster. The unexpected residual charge must be reconciled as a shutdown and account-safety issue, not as authorization to resume ad work.
